      function toast(msg,type='success'){

      t.className='toast toast-'+type;

      function genTakedown(){
      655+

      663+

      664+
      <p>Dear ${plat} Trust &amp; Safety Team,</p>
      665+
      <p>I write on behalf of <strong>${cl.name}</strong> (${cl.sector}) to formally request the immediate removal of the fraudulent account detailed below, which is impersonating our client in violation of your platform's Terms of Service and the Kenya Computer Misuse &amp; Cybercrimes Act 2018.</p>
      666+
      <h2>Infringing Account Details</h2><table><tr><td width="40%"><strong>Account / Page Name</strong></td><td>${th.name}</td></tr><tr><td><strong>Platform</strong></td><td>${th.platform}</td></tr><tr><td><strong>URL / Profile Link</strong></td><td>${th.url||'Available on request'}</td></tr><tr><td><strong>Contact Used</strong></td><td>${th.phone||'—'}</td></tr><tr><td><strong>Date Discovered</strong></td><td>${fd(th.dateFound)}</td></tr></table>
      667+

This violates your platform's policies on: (a) impersonation of individuals and organizations; (b) fraudulent and deceptive conduct; (c) coordinated inauthentic behaviour.</p>${th.desc?'<p>'+th.desc+'</p>':''}
      668+
      <h2>Evidence of Fraud</h2><p>${th.evidence||'Screenshots of the fraudulent account, victim testimonies, and M-Pesa transaction records are held and available to your trust &amp; safety team on request.'}</p><p>Estimated victims: <strong>${th.victims||0}</strong>. Estimated losses: <strong>${fm(th.amount)}</strong>.</p>
      669+
      <h2>Relief Requested</h2><p>1. <strong>Immediate suspension</strong> of the infringing account pending investigation.<br>2. <strong>Permanent removal</strong> upon confirmation of fraudulent activity.<br>3. <strong>Preservation of records</strong> (IP logs, account data, payment info) to assist the Kenya DCI Cybercrime Unit.<br>4. <strong>Written confirmation</strong> of action taken, referencing case number ${rn}.</p>

      <p>A parallel complaint has been filed with the Kenya DCI Cybercrime Unit. Their contact for platform liaison: ${D.settings.dci||'cybercrime@dci.go.ke / 0800 722 203'}.</p>
      671+
      <p>We trust your platform will act swiftly to protect ${cl.name}'s community from further harm.</p>
